description: This file implements Windows-specific asynchronous IO operations, including handle management, IO completion processing, and deadline handling for file operations in the 'winio' package.

classes.name: win32File
classes.description: Represents a Windows handle with asynchronous IO capabilities, including methods for reading, writing, closing, and managing IO deadlines.

classes.name: timeoutHandler
classes.description: Handles deadline timing and timeout signaling for IO operations.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the win32File, cancelling ongoing IO and releasing resources.

methods.name: IsClosed
methods.description: Checks if the file handle has been closed.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous read operation on the handle.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous write operation on the handle.

methods.name: SetReadDeadline
methods.description: Sets a deadline for read operations.

methods.name: SetWriteDeadline
methods.description: Sets a deadline for write operations.

methods.name: Fd
methods.description: Returns the file descriptor (handle) as uintptr.
